verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Vue's TypeScript type inference (defineProps) and an llms.txt documentation bundle, but no first-party AI tooling that automatically detects and resolves type errors. llms.txt is an adjacent building block, not the capability itself. A framework ecosystem could plausibly ship such tooling, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an ai-native developer, I can use AI tooling that automatically resolves type errors surfaced by the framework's type system
